energy.label: Oil, gas & power
energy.note: Oil and gas is often targeted by country sanctions programs (e.g. Iran, Russia, Venezuela). Check where the cargo comes from, the vessels used and who is buying it.

mining.label: Mining & metals
mining.note: Gold, diamonds and some minerals feature in sanctions on Sudan, DRC, CAR, Russia and Venezuela. Lenders and insurers often expect conflict-minerals due diligence (OECD guidance).

shipping.label: Shipping & logistics
shipping.note: Vessel ownership, flag and gaps in tracking data matter. Screen IMO numbers against designated vessels, including 'shadow fleet' designations.

transport.label: Transport & logistics
transport.note: Check vessels, aircraft and freight routes against designated vessels and transit-country regimes.

finance.label: Banking & finance
finance.note: Correspondent-banking exposure. Check for links to designated banks, money service businesses and exchange houses.

bank.label: Banking
bank.note: Correspondent-banking exposure. Check for links to designated banks, money service businesses and exchange houses.

defence.label: Defence & dual-use
defence.note: UN arms embargoes and export controls (e.g. the US BIS Entity List) apply. Export-control lists are not screened in this demo.

telecom.label: Telecoms & tech
telecom.note: Export controls on telecoms and dual-use equipment (e.g. the US Entity List) are not screened in this demo.

tech.label: Technology
tech.note: Export controls on telecoms and dual-use equipment (e.g. the US Entity List) are not screened in this demo.

agri.label: Agriculture & commodities
agri.note: Usually lower sanctions sensitivity. Watch timber, charcoal (UN Somalia ban) and sourcing from conflict zones.
